name: crew-board
description: Live board of /crew agents: state, phase, progress and stale warnings, read from ~/.crew

port.title: Web view port
port.description: Port for /crew-board serve, the web view for a browser or phone.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: on: send a notification when an agent becomes blocked (waits for the captain), fails or goes stale. off: no notifications.

style.title: Board style
style.description: full: faces with hats on the ship, a hat in each row, and a blank line between terminal rows. simple: small dots for the crew and compact rows.
